seasons.title: Blood and Badges
seasons.arc_summary: The party establishes themselves in Hallia, taking courier jobs that unravel a conspiracy of flesh-monster impostors, illegal augury, and radar dishes spreading a mysterious signal. The arc culminates in their descent into the Quiet Below and discovery of Master Grayson's necromantic experiments inside a Fane of the Pulse.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: A disastrous ambush at the Crowded Flea leaves three party members dead, sending survivors through the Black and White to meet the entity Aut. Resurrected but diminished, the party reforms with Sir Arctos, hunts down Hlarf and Tywelwyn Leatherhide, and discovers six alien gods are using radar dishes to crack the Firmament and invade Færrin.

seasons.title: The Keystone Hunt
seasons.arc_summary: The party reports their findings to the Convox and Inquisition, rescues Anaïs from an Aut-branded trap, and learns of the cosmic 'Narrative' family. They attend the Pilgrimage at Ragged Roost, survive a gladiatorial trial, and pursue a keystone scavenger hunt across Hallia—trading stolen art to a sentient transit heart to secure passage aboard a colossal Strider.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: Argyle returns from the dead in altered form, and after a six-month downtime the party investigates the quarantined Teller's Run through the sewers. They discover a hairline fracture in reality with a two-mile-tall imprisoned god behind it, a research compound engineering a harmony to shatter the Firmament, and a conspiracy reaching the Prime Minister—culminating in a bombing that collapses the underground facility.

seasons.title: Aboard the Providence
seasons.arc_summary: The party boards the colossal Strider alongside nineteen rival factions, creates their own heart 'Eerie,' and navigates deadly politics including a weekly energy tithe that kills the unprepared. They forge a coalition of smaller factions, explore the Strider's Undercroft to ally with an ancient Machine God, and begin assaulting the Herald's cultists hidden within the Strider's depths.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: Season 1 — The Cagley Middle Finale
seasons.arc_summary: Noah's Cagley Middle one-shot reaches its conclusion as the 8th-grade heroes descend into the Terror of Cagley's lair and slay the shadow demon.

seasons.title: The Verdant Expanse
seasons.arc_summary: Convox detectives investigate husk-murders in the logging town of Wrenford, tracking a mysterious suspect into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse where they encounter fey courts, cursed children, and a growing supernatural threat.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: Following fey stone leads into the heart of Hallia, the detectives uncover a ritual transmutation operation tied to a cursed book — the Gloaming Codex — and are pulled into its pages to fight for their lives against carnivorous ink and cursed thoughts.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: Sedecium Fire Team
seasons.arc_summary: Three Sedecium agents — Old Man Scrazzy, Lieutenant Foral, and Ozzie — carry out high-risk missions across the slip and beyond, first investigating a derelict orbital observatory to uncover a Thessian's plot, then mounting a daring raid on the divine essence of a freshly-killed god before the God Eater Harrow can consume it all.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
